name: g08-data
prompt:
ENG-G08: skinned meshes are skinned on the GPU. A compute shader (shaders/skin.comp) reads each model mesh's bind vertices and each instance's skin matrices and jiggle zones from storage buffers and writes kke::Vertex (11 floats: position, overlay position = bind position, normal, uv) into the vertex buffer the draw passes already read. kke/GpuSkin.h packs those buffers on the CPU and holds a CPU copy of the shader's maths for the tests. C++20, glm, Vulkan, GLSL 450 std430. Add `void packSkinData(const std::vector<glm::mat4>& skin, const std::vector<SkinJiggleOffset>& zones, std::vector<glm::vec4>& out)` (declared in kke/GpuSkin.h, in context) after packSkinBind and before `} // namespace kke`. Keep every line already there. One short `//` line above it. Body:
`out.clear();`, `out.reserve(skin.size() * kSkinVec4sPerBone + zones.size() * kSkinVec4sPerZone);`; for each `const glm::mat4& m : skin`, `for (int c = 0; c < 4; ++c) out.push_back(m[c]);`; then for each `const SkinJiggleOffset& z : zones`, push_back `glm::vec4(z.center, z.radius)` and then `glm::vec4(z.offset, 0.0f)`.
